    <ReasonCode kb="ROR" kxe="false">Unknown internal error.</ReasonCode>
    <Message kb="ROO" kxe="false"> REST0126 Please find error details below
[HSCL2957 Either there is currently no RMC connection between the management console and the partition 1 or the partition does not support dynamic partitioning operations. Verify the network setup on the management console and the partition and ensure that any firewall authentication between the management console and the partition has occurred. Run the management console diagrmc command to identify problems that might be causing no RMC connection.
]</Message>
